text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on October 9 and 10, 2024. October 9, 2024 Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Chow to address City Council for a presentation in recognition of 150 years of firefighting in Toronto. Mayor Chow welcomed the following guests to the Council Chamber: Interim Fire Chief Larry Cocco; Deputy Fire Chiefs Jim Jessop, Paul Fitzgerald, Kevin Hamilton and Laura Boyko and other Toronto Fire Services Staff members; Toronto Professional Fire Fighters Association President James Reid and their executive team; Toronto Paramedic Services Chief Bikram Chawla; Toronto Police Service Staff Superintendent Brett Nicol; and members of the Toronto Fire Historical Society, the Toronto Fire Services Honour Guard, the Toronto Fire Services Pipes and Drums Band, and the Toronto Fire Services…
